#### LAE equivalence calculations

```{r}

lae_equivalence_curve <- function(fit, grid, env_vars = c("AmbientEnvCore", "AmbientVariant"),
                                  lae_var = "UASLAEMaxLRScl", target_levels = c(1, 3.5, 6),
                                  re_formula = NULL, allow_new_levels = TRUE,
                                  sample_new_levels = "gaussian",
                                  ndraws = NULL, seed = NULL, transform = identity) {
  pred <- brms::posterior_epred(fit, newdata = grid, re_formula = re_formula,
                                allow_new_levels = allow_new_levels,
                                sample_new_levels = sample_new_levels,
                                ndraws = ndraws, seed = seed)
  pred <- transform(pred)   # ndraws x nrow(grid)

  env_key <- do.call(paste, c(grid[env_vars], sep = " | "))
  lae_key <- grid[[lae_var]]
  combos <- unique(data.frame(env = env_key, lae = lae_key))

  # per-draw mean prediction at each unique (env, LAE) grid combination -
  # collapses over whatever else varies in `grid` (simulated ID/StimID, between-subject covariates)
  combo_draws <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(combos)), function(i) {
    idx <- env_key == combos$env[i] & lae_key == combos$lae[i]
    rowMeans(pred[, idx, drop = FALSE])
  })   # ndraws x n_combos

  purrr::map_dfr(unique(combos$env), function(e) {
    cidx <- combos$env == e
    ord <- order(combos$lae[cidx])
    lae_vals <- combos$lae[cidx][ord]
    draws_sub <- combo_draws[, cidx, drop = FALSE][, ord, drop = FALSE]

    monotonic_frac <- mean(apply(draws_sub, 1, function(row) !is.unsorted(row)))
    if (monotonic_frac < 0.99) {
      warning(e, ": only ", round(monotonic_frac * 100, 1),
              "% of draws are monotonic in LAE - inversion is unreliable for the rest.")
    }

    purrr::map_dfr(target_levels, function(tgt) {
      lae_at_tgt <- apply(draws_sub, 1, function(y_draw) {
        if (!is.unsorted(y_draw) && tgt >= min(y_draw) && tgt <= max(y_draw)) {
          stats::approx(x = y_draw, y = lae_vals, xout = tgt, ties = "ordered")$y
        } else {
          NA_real_   # target outside this draw's range, or draw non-monotonic - don't extrapolate
        }
      })
      tibble::tibble(
        env = e, target_dAnnoyance = tgt,
        LAE_Estimate = mean(lae_at_tgt, na.rm = TRUE),
        LAE_Q2.5  = stats::quantile(lae_at_tgt, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
        LAE_Q97.5 = stats::quantile(lae_at_tgt, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
        pct_valid = 100 * mean(!is.na(lae_at_tgt)),
        draws = list(lae_at_tgt)
      )
    })
  })
}

lae_shift_between <- function(equivalence_result, ref_env, compare_env) {
  purrr::map_dfr(unique(equivalence_result$target_dAnnoyance), function(tgt) {
    ref <- equivalence_result$draws[equivalence_result$env == ref_env &
                                    equivalence_result$target_dAnnoyance == tgt][[1]]
    cmp <- equivalence_result$draws[equivalence_result$env == compare_env &
                                    equivalence_result$target_dAnnoyance == tgt][[1]]
    shift <- cmp - ref
    tibble::tibble(
      comparison = paste(compare_env, "-", ref_env), target_dAnnoyance = tgt,
      LAE_shift_dB = mean(shift, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q2.5 = stats::quantile(shift, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q97.5 = stats::quantile(shift, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_valid = 100 * mean(!is.na(shift))
    )
  })
}

eq_curve <- lae_equivalence_curve(
  mdA31, grid = subset(grid_marg_lae_sweep, UASEvents == 1),
  target_levels = 0:6,
  re_formula = NULL, allow_new_levels = TRUE, sample_new_levels = "gaussian",
  ndraws = ndraws_pred, seed = 999, transform = transform_dAnnoy
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(LAE_Estimate=LAE_Estimate + mean(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLR, na.rm=TRUE),
                LAE_Q2.5=LAE_Q2.5 + mean(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLR, na.rm=TRUE),
                LAE_Q97.5=LAE_Q97.5 + mean(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLR, na.rm=TRUE))

mdA31EnvShift <- dplyr::bind_rows(lae_shift_between(eq_curve, ref_env = "Park | Standard", compare_env = "Highway | Standard"),
                                  lae_shift_between(eq_curve, ref_env = "Park | Standard", compare_env = "Streetside square | Standard"),
                                  lae_shift_between(eq_curve, ref_env = "Park | Standard", compare_env = "Residential | Standard"),
                                  lae_shift_between(eq_curve, ref_env = "Park | Standard", compare_env = "Park | ParkHigh"),
                                  lae_shift_between(eq_curve, ref_env = "Park | Standard", compare_env = "Highway | HighwayLow"),
                                  lae_shift_between(eq_curve, ref_env = "Residential | Standard", compare_env = "Highway | Standard"),
                                  lae_shift_between(eq_curve, ref_env = "Residential | Standard", compare_env = "Highway | HighwayLow"),
                                  lae_shift_between(eq_curve, ref_env = "Residential | Standard", compare_env = "Streetside square | Standard"))

mdA31EnvShift[mdA31EnvShift$pct_valid > 95,]

  filename = "dAnnoyMn_ExpLAEMod_EnvdBShift_brmsOb"
  
  utils::write.csv(mdA31EnvShift, paste(outDataPath, "\\", filename, ".csv", sep=""))
  
}
```
